gloss: triangular bandage; arm sling; (kitchen) triangular head scarf

definitions.explanation: A triangular cloth used in first aid to immobilize an injured arm or support a wound. A standard item in school and workplace first-aid kits.

definitions.gloss: triangular head scarf (worn in cooking class)
definitions.explanation: A triangular cloth worn over the hair to keep it out of food. Standard equipment for elementary school cooking classes and school lunch duty.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{三角|さんかく}→三角：04177_sankaku⟧ (triangle) + {巾|きん} (cloth). The same shaped cloth is used for two unrelated purposes: emergency first aid and keeping hair out of food.

SENSE 1 — FIRST AID:
- An essential item in any ⟦{救急箱|きゅうきゅうばこ}→救急箱：19410_kyuukyuubako⟧ (first-aid kit).
- Used to make an arm sling, secure a splint, or cover a wound.

SENSE 2 — KITCHEN:
- Standard kit for ⟦{給食|きゅうしょく}→給食：13800_kyuushoku⟧⟦{当番|とうばん}→当番：04564_touban⟧ (school-lunch duty) and ⟦{調理|ちょうり}→調理：07156_chouri⟧⟦{実習|じっしゅう}→実習：03077_jisshuu⟧ (cooking class), worn together with an apron.
- Often the first thing a Japanese child learns to wear in a domestic kitchen setting.
